title: Before sunrise at Macy's, a familiar Black Friday ritual returns despite weeks of online deals
summary: Black Friday produces more foot traffic at physical stores than any other day despite growing competition from e-commerce and brands rolling out steep holiday discounts online weeks in advance, according to retail technology company Sensormatic Solutions.

title: As Google threatens to cut schools' search access, Los Angeles blocks AI features
summary: The LA district, which enrolls half a million students, has made no formal announcement, and the move caught parents and students by surprise, said Bridie Lee, a leader of Schools Beyond Screens LA.

title: Heavy rain winds down as power remains out for hundreds of thousands on the East Coast
summary: The storms snarled travel, downed trees and power lines and led to water rescues from New York to Virginia.

title: Serbia's student movement proposes a chemistry professor for presidency ahead of Dec. 27 ballot
summary: The presidential vote comes after the student movement defeated former President Aleksandar Vucic's right-wing Serbian Progressive Party in an early parliamentary ballot on Oct. 25.

title: Zelenskyy urges the U.S. to pressure Putin, calling Trump's 'my friend' remark strange
summary: "He can't be a friend," Zelenskyy told the BBC in Kyiv, likening it to someone calling Adolf Hitler a friend during World War II.
